events.factual_description: The Hamilton Live's authorized EVENTIM page lists Minyo Crusaders for Thursday, September 24, 2026 in Washington, DC, with doors at 6:30 PM and the show at 8:00 PM, and identifies Mariposas Galácticas as support. The same event page describes Minyo Crusaders as a Tokyo-based 12-piece ensemble reimagining Japanese min'yō through cumbia, reggae, Afro-Caribbean, African and related global rhythmic languages. Universal Music Japan's official Minyo Crusaders site identifies this September 22-30 run as the band's first North American tour and lists seven cities, including Brooklyn, Philadelphia and Washington on consecutive dates. The tour follows the June 26, 2026 release of From Japan With Love, whose arrangements combine regional Japanese folk melodies with salsa, cumbia, Afrobeat and other groove traditions. Individual Minyo Crusaders personnel for the Hamilton engagement are not listed on the exact event page and are therefore not inferred.

en.why_it_matters: This lands almost exactly where the RADAR's Japan, Latin and groove threads cross. Minyo Crusaders do not preserve min'yō behind glass: a 12-piece Tokyo band takes regional Japanese work songs and dance melodies and pushes them through cumbia, salsa, reggae, Afrobeat and other rhythmic languages until the old material functions again as social music. The Washington stop is also part of the band's first North American tour and arrives with From Japan With Love still fresh. Mariposas Galácticas deepen the idea rather than merely fill the opening slot, bringing a Philadelphia cumbia-klezmer-punk vocabulary built from another set of diasporic traditions.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the Washington date if September 24 is open. It is unusually well matched to Listening Notes and The Hamilton is local, so there is little reason to chase the nearby Brooklyn or Philadelphia stops unless the DC night conflicts with something stronger. The multi-city tour also means the music is important without pretending this particular stop is a one-shot rarity.

es.why_it_matters: Esta fecha cae casi exactamente donde se cruzan los hilos de Japón, Latin y groove del RADAR. Minyo Crusaders no conserva el min'yō detrás de una vitrina: una banda tokiota de 12 músicos toma canciones de trabajo y melodías regionales japonesas y las pasa por cumbia, salsa, reggae, Afrobeat y otros lenguajes rítmicos hasta volverlas otra vez música social. La parada de Washington forma además parte de la primera gira norteamericana del grupo y llega con From Japan With Love todavía recién salido. Mariposas Galácticas profundiza la idea en vez de ocupar simplemente el turno de apertura, con una mezcla de cumbia, klezmer y punk nacida de otra combinación de tradiciones diaspóricas.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a la fecha de Washington si el 24 de septiembre está libre. Embona de manera excepcional con Listening Notes y The Hamilton es local, así que no hay mucha razón para perseguir las paradas cercanas de Brooklyn o Filadelfia salvo que la noche de DC choque con algo más fuerte. La gira de varias ciudades también permite tratar la música como importante sin fingir que esta parada particular es una oportunidad irrepetible.
